remarks: Welcome to this charming ground-level corner unit in a well-maintained condominium complex, perfectly situated in a prime Stamford location. This 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home features the best of convenience and comfort. Large sliders off the dining and living room flood the space with natural light and seamlessly blend indoor and outdoor living. Step outside to your private back patio, offering a serene setting to unwind or access the complex's desirable amenities including a pool and clubhouse, ideal for relaxation and socializing. Enjoy easy access to major highways, the train station, and NYC, making your commute a breeze. You'll also be just moments away from excellent shopping and dining options.. This is the perfect opportunity to enjoy all that Stamford living has to enjoy!
